# Actions pinned by the workflow-template sync.
#
# The sync workflow records the md5 of each template it copies here, so an
# unchanged template is skipped on the next run. Only files that already exist
# under .github/workflows/ are tracked; the file starts empty and is populated
# on the first sync.
